; The Old Crypt's text sheet (Engine 0.16 part C T3): frames cut, flipped, turned and pasted
; from the CC0 DungeonTileset II sheet (assets/dungeon-tileset-ii/sheet.png, credited in
; assets/CREDITS.md) where the skin needs a piece the sheet has no rectangle for (wall joins,
; doors in side walls, turned blades and arrows, white hit flashes, floors in a wall's shadow),
; plus original pieces in the pack's colours (the brazier and its flame, the key, the panel,
; the padlock). Made by a small generator; edit by hand now.
; Palette: content/palettes/crypt-floor.json.
